newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines to import 27,000 tonnes of sugar.
newsitem.headline: Philippines to import 27,000 tonnes of sugar.

text.p: Philippine Agriculture Secretary Salvador Escudero said on Thursday he had ordered the immediate importation of 27,000 tonnes of sugar to fill up the additional quota given by the United States for the crop year 1996-1997.
Escudero told reporters the shipment should be done by the middle of August so it would reach the United States before the crop year ends in September.
Any delay in the shipment may result in the loss of opportunity to avail of the additional U.S. sugar quota allocation, he said.
Under the quota system, the U.S. buys sugar from select trading partners at a premium.
